name: autoclipping-tools
description: Pipeline tools the agent can call: transcript -> moment selection -> cutting -> per-clip analysis -> publishing.
note: Hermes Agent discovers tools via MCP (stdio or remote HTTP MCP servers), not a polled manifest. This file is the tool contract used by the POST /tools/{name} bridge in app.py and as the source for an MCP wrapper. See PROJECT_STATUS.md > architecture note.

transport.call: POST /tools/{tool_name} with a JSON body of the tool's inputs

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Extract a timestamped plain-text transcript for a YouTube or Twitch video (captions, else faster-whisper).

output_schema.description: One segment per line, each prefixed with [HH:MM:SS].

tools.name: identify_moments
tools.description: From a transcript, return the top TEN clip-worthy windows (each <=2 minutes, on natural sentence boundaries; clipper adds a 2s lead buffer).

tools.name: cut_clips
tools.description: Cut segments from a source video and convert each to 9:16 vertical; writes to /tmp/clips.

video_path.description: Local path to the source video

tools.name: analyze_clips
tools.description: For each rendered clip, return the best 30-90s moment, a caption, and a virality score.

tools.name: publish_clips
tools.description: Upload clips to Blotato and create a post per connected target (useNextFreeSlot).
